messages.text: Read the retry panel spec and the existing backoff helper.
The helper only retries on 5xx; the spec wants 429 with Retry-After honoured too.
Added a case for 429. Retry-After can be seconds or an HTTP date, so both are parsed.
An HTTP date in the past has to clamp to zero rather than sleep negative.
Wrote the table test: 5xx, 429-seconds, 429-date, 429-date-in-the-past, 4xx-no-retry.
4xx must NOT retry, and that was the one the old helper got wrong.
Suite green: 618 passed.
Wrote the user-guide section for the new retry panel.
The OpenAPI examples mention the old backoff field — updated them to match what I built.
Draft PR #211 is up with both screenshots.
Review comment: use the shared RetryPolicy instead of a local one. Fair — doing that.
Swapped it. The shared policy already handles the jittered case, so the sleep moved into it.
That deleted 30 lines net.
Re-ran the suite after the swap. Still green.
One flake in the date test: it used the real clock. Pinned it to a fixed instant.
Pushed. PR is ready for a second look.
Second review: asked for the clamp to be its own named function. Done.
Rebased on main — one conflict in the helper, taken ours plus their new import.
622 passed / 0 failed after the rebase.
Squashed to three commits: the parse, the clamp, the docs.
Waiting on CI before I mark it ready.
CI green. Marked ready for review.
Starting the migration that drops the old backoff column.
All three cases covered. Running the full suite before I touch the migration.
